title: Blackbox: First Steps
summary: Set up the first safe Blackbox loop before widening the route.

blocks.title: Start Small
blocks.body: Read records before acting on them. Store unusual fragments, compare names in Wiki or Terminal, and avoid using directive items until you understand the route cost.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: A safe Blackbox start means reading before acting. Store named fragments, compare records, and treat unusual directives as decisions with consequences.

blocks.title: Before You Expand
blocks.body: Name the goal, the exit, and the resource or signal that proves Blackbox is helping. If any of those are vague, keep the next run shorter.

blocks.title: Ready Check
blocks.body: Before moving on, confirm the first setup step is repeatable and safe enough to do again.
